description:
This is a notice of intent to award a noncompetitive contract action. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), Acquisition and Grants Office (AGO), Western Acquisition Division (WAD) and the NOAA Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) intends to award a noncompetitive contract action for Advanced Operations, Engineering, and Architecture Information Technology (IT) Support Services.

Please see the attached document for the complete notice of intent.
